messages:
Priya: Pushed a docs PR for a Windows offline install flow + KMS/HSM appendix. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5015. Covers HTTPS artifact mirror, SMB appendix, PKCS#11 hints, and a short migration checklist.

Ben: Nice. Question: which mirror pattern are we recommending as default? HTTPS seems safer over WAN.

Priya: Agreed. Main flow uses HTTPS (Invoke-WebRequest/curl). SMB kept as Appendix with credential and SMBv2/3 notes.

Carlos: Add these items before merge: 1) driver signing requirement for Windows HSMs and a short registry/GPO snippet; 2) example PKCS#11 module paths for YubiHSM2, Thales Luna, SafeNet; 3) an explicit vendor-install order: vendor driver -> middleware -> redwood-agent.

Priya: Done. I added a tiny vendor table and the registry snippet to enforce driver signing. Also included a PowerShell checksum validation one-liner: 
Get-FileHash .\redwood-installer.zip -Algorithm SHA256 | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Hash | ForEach-Object { if ($_ -ne 'REPLACE_SHA256') { throw 'checksum mismatch' } }

Ben: CI windows-smoke failed on the branch with an SMB auth error. Log excerpt: 
2026-03-05T11:21:07Z ERROR installer: map network drive failed: Access denied
Looks like the net use example needs clearer credentials guidance.

Priya: I added a net use example showing /user:DOMAIN\svc_redwood and a note to create a read-only service account scoped to the artifacts share. Also clarified how to persist creds for the installer VM.

Carlos: For the HSM appendix, call out that some vendors install PKCS11 middleware to Program Files and others under Program Files (x86). Give examples rather than absolutes. Also mention restarting the redwood service after vendor middleware install.

Priya: Added that and a short troubleshooting checklist (check Windows Event Log, verify pkcs11 path, restart service).

link-bot: link-checker/5015 completed. Found 1 broken relative link to /guides/migrate-linux -> suggest /guides/migrate-from-linux.

Priya: Fixed the link and pushed. Can folks do a quick review? I want to merge before the docs freeze tomorrow.

qa-bot: windows-smoke re-run queued. Will report back.

Ben: LGTM for infra. Tiny wording nit: avoid \"open ports\" — use \"allow egress to mirror host on port 443 (HTTPS) or 445 (SMB) as applicable\".

Carlos: LGTM after confirming the driver-signing note is in. Approve pending CI.

Priya: Thanks! If QA passes I’ll merge and then open a small follow-up PR with a migration-from-linux quick checklist (export KMS keys, install vendor drivers, map PKCS#11 to agent, run windows-smoke).
